evidence.restatement: The Greek text on the Rosetta Stone gave scholars, Champollion above all, the key to working out Egyptian hieroglyphs.

Cuneiform was cracked largely through the trilingual Behistun inscription, Linear B by Michael Ventris in 1952 from its own tablets, and Maya glyphs through 20th-century work such as Knorozov's; none of these relied on the Rosetta Stone.
The stone records a decree of Ptolemy V issued at Memphis in 196 BC, written three times: in hieroglyphs, in demotic and in Greek.
